head: 타일 줄눈 청소, 순서대로 따라하기
prompt: Close-up overhead shot of a Korean woman's hands scrubbing bathroom floor tile grout lines with a small stiff-bristled brush, white foamy cleaning paste worked into the grout gaps, wet tile surface glistening under soft overhead bathroom light, a spray bottle and folded cloth resting just outside the frame, shot at a low angle almost parallel to the floor to emphasize the grout lines, realistic phone-camera quality with slight shadow from the person's arm
alt: 욕실 바닥 타일 줄눈을 솔로 문질러 닦는 손 클로즈업 사진

head: 실리콘 틈새 곰팡이, 안쪽까지 없애는 법
prompt: Macro-angle photo of a Korean woman's hand pressing a cotton pad soaked in cleaning solution into the black-spotted silicone caulk line where the bathtub meets the wall tile, thin plastic scraper tucked between her fingers, dim humid bathroom lighting with a slight reflection on the wet silicone surface, shot from a low side angle to show the depth of the caulk groove, candid unstaged look with a slightly damp towel visible in the blurred background
alt: 욕조와 벽 사이 실리콘 틈새 곰팡이 부분에 세정액 적신 화장솜을 붙이는 모습

head: 유리 부스와 거울 물때 제거법
prompt: Side-angle photo of a Korean woman wiping a foggy, water-spotted glass shower door with a squeegee in one hand and a microfiber cloth in the other, visible streak marks clearing away mineral water stains as she pulls the squeegee downward, natural window light coming through a small bathroom window creating soft reflections on the wet glass, shot from slightly behind and to the side at shoulder height, realistic candid home photo feel
alt: 유리 샤워 부스의 물때를 스퀴지로 밀어내며 닦는 모습
